measurement: trusted browser click to visible DOM after two animation frames; not a compositor or physical-display stopwatch
clock: browser performance clock bracketed by five Node RPC round trips; minimum-width interval retained, no unbounded clock subtraction
population: Every base-plan position/cold-warm/rung/sample remains. Pattern uses the real UI. Higher rungs use the UI only after an available predecessor; otherwise retain not_reachable with the literal predecessor. Move is separately measured at REST and must also have a disabled UI ceiling. Voice/source-off arms use the real pattern seat. Each voice arm retains a separate deterministic baseline.
cold: fresh application with real Stockfish, fresh Hint and candidate caches; browser navigation is part of production and any pre-acquisition is reported, not reset
warm: new run, same FEN/application; check literal retained source acquisition and packet hit
voice: local timeout/empty-output transport, never a paid LLM; browser preference requests persona through the current workflow-v2 codec
sourceOffModules: Retain actual post-commit named structure/theory API receipts. This independent control is not browser paint for those modules.
receiptRules: Keep all failed and unreachable rows; no pruning timing outliers
Missing or hidden DOM is not a render
Mutation time is not the post-frame visibility time
Retain response identities, deterministic sentence bytes and literal dependency trace
Cold/warm, voice and source-off populations remain distinct
